title: A paragraph that tells file status 02, 22 and 23 apart after each access to an indexed file
shapes: AIXA AIXAKSD 9000-STATUS: IF WS-ORD-STATUS = '23' ... IF WS-ORD-STATUS = '02' ... IF WS-ORD-STATUS = '22', PERFORMed after each WRITE and after the random READ
asserts: 9000-STATUS is one units fact, PERFORMed from 1000-ADD (three times) and 3000-PROBE (plain edges facts). The comparisons are tests of the FILE STATUS item named in the SELECT (WS-ORD-STATUS, file_status of ORD-FILE). At run time the second WRITE (a new prime key, a customer already present) ends in status 02, the third WRITE (an existing prime key) in 22 and the random READ of a missing key in 23: 02 is a success, 22 and 23 are not.
